title: Descent of a finite Galois representative with invariant germ
statement: Let $K\subset K_s\subset\Omega$ be a compatible tower of fields [def-pc-field-extension], where $K_s$ is a separable closure of $K$ [def-kun-separably-closed] and $\Omega$ is algebraically closed and algebraic over $K$. Let $s=\operatorname{Spec}(K\to\Omega)$ be the canonical geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point] and $F$ a sheaf of sets on the small etale site of $\operatorname{Spec}K$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Write $M$ for its geometric stalk at $s$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. Let $G=\operatorname{Gal}(K_s/K)$ act on $M$, with $g\cdot[X,x,z]=[X,\operatorname{Spec}(\tau);x,z]$ for every $K$-automorphism $\tau$ of $\Omega$ extending $g$. Let $L/K$ be a finite separable intermediate field of $K_s/K$, $E/K$ a finite Galois intermediate field containing $L$, and $x,y$ the canonical lifts to $\operatorname{Spec}L,\operatorname{Spec}E$ induced by the field inclusions. Suppose the germ map $F(\operatorname{Spec}E)\to M$ at $y$ is injective. If $z\in F(\operatorname{Spec}E)$ has germ fixed by every element of $\operatorname{Gal}(K_s/L)$, there is $w\in F(\operatorname{Spec}L)$ whose germ at $x$ equals the germ of $z$ at $y$.

source.place: Tag 04JM (lemma-global-sections-point), direct proof; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/04JM

proof.text: Every L-automorphism of E extends to an automorphism of Ks fixing L by normality of the separable closure, then to Omega. Naturality and the supplied lift-change formula identify its pullback germ with the group action on the germ of z. The fixed-germ hypothesis and supplied injectivity imply equality of the pullback section with z.

Restrict the sheaf along etale composition from Spec L to Spec K. This preserves covers. Since E/L is finite Galois, finite Galois sections descent gives w whose pullback is z. The canonical lifts are compatible with L contained in E, so naturality of the stalk injections identifies the germs of w and z.

proof_origin.place: Tag 04JM, direct proof, specialized to the canonical lifts over L; second-reader formal reduction G3

theorem exists_fieldSection_of_finiteGalois_invariant_representative
    (K Ks Ω : Type u) [Field K] [Field Ks] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra K Ks] [IsSepClosure K Ks] [Algebra Ks Ω] [Algebra K Ω]
    [IsScalarTower K Ks Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic K Ω]
    (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (.of K))
    (hs : s = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))
    (F : Sheaf (Spec (.of K)).smallEtaleTopology (Type (max (u + 1) v)))
    (action : MulAction Gal(Ks/K) ((pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber.obj F))
    (haction : ∀ (g : Gal(Ks/K)) (τ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω)
      (hτ : (algebraMap Ks Ω).comp g.toRingHom =
        τ.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap Ks Ω))
      (X : (Spec (.of K)).Etale) (x x' : (pointSmallEtale s).fiber.obj X)
      (hx : x'.left = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom τ.toRingHom) ≫ x.left)
      (z : F.obj.obj (op X)),
      action.smul g ((pointSmallEtale s).toPresheafFiber X x F.obj z) =
        (pointSmallEtale s).toPresheafFiber X x' F.obj z)
    (L : IntermediateField K Ks) [FiniteDimensional K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]
    (x : (pointSmallEtale s).fiber.obj (etaleSpec K L))
    (hx : x.left = Spec.map
      (CommRingCat.ofHom ((algebraMap Ks Ω).comp L.subtype)))
    (E : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField K Ks) (hLE : L ≤ E.toIntermediateField)
    (y : (pointSmallEtale s).fiber.obj (etaleSpec K E))
    (hy : y.left = Spec.map
      (CommRingCat.ofHom ((algebraMap Ks Ω).comp E.toIntermediateField.subtype)))
    (z : F.obj.obj (op (etaleSpec K E)))
    (hinj : Function.Injective
      ((pointSmallEtale s).toPresheafFiber (etaleSpec K E) y F.obj))
    (hz : ∀ g ∈ L.fixingSubgroup,
      action.smul g ((pointSmallEtale s).toPresheafFiber (etaleSpec K E) y F.obj z) =
        (pointSmallEtale s).toPresheafFiber (etaleSpec K E) y F.obj z) :
    ∃ w : F.obj.obj (op (etaleSpec K L)),
      (pointSmallEtale s).toPresheafFiber (etaleSpec K L) x F.obj w =
        (pointSmallEtale s).toPresheafFiber (etaleSpec K E) y F.obj z
